# Access Layer — System Architecture and Integration Topology

## Purpose (sec-001)

This document describes the system layers in use across the organisation and which integration processes operate at each layer. It is used by the triage agent to determine which platform a suspected error originates from, and which team owns that platform.

## Layer Overview (sec-002)

The integration architecture is organised into five layers. Member-facing traffic enters at the Presentation Layer (MemberPortal, Sitecore) and flows through the Integration Layer (Boomi) into the Application Layer (Salesforce, NetSuite, EventManagementSystem). External services (PaymentGateway, NotificationService) operate at the External Layer. Identity and access management sits in the Security Layer (IdentityProvider).

## Access Layer

- **Schema version:** 1.1
- **Last reviewed:** 2024-08-15
- **Reviewed by:** platform.ops@example.com

### Presentation (layer-001)

- **Description:** Member-facing systems and content delivery. Traffic at this layer is initiated by members or staff through a browser or mobile interface. Errors here typically manifest as UI failures, failed form submissions, or content not rendering.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** MemberSystemsTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** member.systems@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #member-portal

#### MemberPortal (sys-001)

- **Description:** The primary self-service portal used by members to update their profile, renew membership, register for events, and submit CPD declarations.
- **Type:** Web Application
- **Technology:** React / Node.js (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** source
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** outbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** OAuth 2.0
        - **Notes:** Emits integration events on member action completion. Events are consumed by Boomi listeners.
- **Owning team:** MemberSystemsTeam
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.5%
    - **RTO:** 4 hours
    - **RPO:** 1 hour
- **Common issues:**
    - Session timeout causing form submission failure — member must re-login
    - Payload validation on address fields occasionally rejects special characters
- **Maintenance window:** Sunday 02:00–04:00 AEST

#### Sitecore (sys-002)

- **Description:** Content management and delivery system used to display member-facing news, resources, and portal profile pages. Receives member profile updates from Salesforce.
- **Type:** CMS
- **Technology:** Sitecore (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** API Key
        - **Notes:** Profile fields written by ContactDetailsSyncProcess after Salesforce update.
- **Owning team:** MemberSystemsTeam
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.0%
    - **RTO:** 8 hours
    - **RPO:** 4 hours
- **Common issues:**
    - 503 errors during deployment windows (Sunday 01:00–03:00 AEST)
    - Occasional cache staleness — profile changes may take up to 15 minutes to appear
- **Maintenance window:** Sunday 01:00–03:00 AEST

### Integration (layer-002)

- **Description:** Middleware and integration platform. All data flows between Presentation, Application, and External layers pass through this layer. Errors at this layer affect multiple downstream systems and are typically the highest priority to diagnose.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** IntegrationTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** integration.ops@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #integration-platform

#### Boomi (sys-003)

- **Description:** The organisation's integration middleware. Hosts all named integration processes (listeners, orchestrators, sub-processes). All member-initiated integration flows pass through this system.
- **Type:** Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS)
- **Technology:** Dell Boomi (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** orchestrator
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** Boomi REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - MemberPortal
        - **Auth method:** Basic Auth (API Token)
        - **Notes:** The supplied boomi_scan.py queries execution records by process name. The prototype Inspect Boomi Log Tool uses the documented Process ID, incident timestamp and affected-person identifiers to retrieve matching executions.
- **Hosted processes:**
    - EmploymentUpdateListener (proc-e1a2b3c4)
    - MembershipRenewalOrchestrator (proc-f2b3c4d5)
    - EventRegistrationSync (proc-g3c4d5e6)
    - ContactDetailsSyncProcess (proc-h4d5e6f7)
    - CPDDeclarationIngestion (proc-i5e6f7g8)
    - MemberFeedbackRouter (proc-j6f7g8h9)
- **Owning team:** IntegrationTeam
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.9%
    - **RTO:** 1 hour
    - **RPO:** 15 minutes
- **Common issues:**
    - Atom restart required after deployment — processes queue during restart window (~5 min)
    - Connector license exhaustion during peak periods (membership renewal cycle)
- **Maintenance window:** Wednesday 22:00–23:30 AEST

### Application (layer-003)

- **Description:** Core business application systems. These hold the organisation's canonical records for members, finances, and events. Errors here affect data integrity and are escalated to the relevant application owner.
- **Owning team:** Not specified (null)
- **Note:** Ownership varies per system — see individual system owningTeam fields.

#### Salesforce (sys-004)

- **Description:** Customer relationship management system. The system of record for member contact information, membership tier, CPD records, and case management. Updated by EmploymentUpdateListener, ContactDetailsSyncProcess, CPDDeclarationIngestion, MemberFeedbackRouter, and EventRegistrationSync.
- **Type:** CRM
- **Technology:** Salesforce (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** OAuth 2.0 (Connected App)
        - **Notes:** Uses ExternalId field on Contact object to match member records by membership number.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** CRMTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** crm.support@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #crm-integrations
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.9%
    - **RTO:** 2 hours
    - **RPO:** 1 hour
- **Common issues:**
    - ExternalId not found — member exists in Portal but not yet created in Salesforce (common for new joiners)
    - Governor limit errors during bulk renewal periods
    - Duplicate contact records causing update ambiguity
- **Key fields:**
    - **Member ID field:** ExternalId__c
    - **Membership status field:** Membership_Status__c
    - **Employer field:** Employer__c
    - **Cpd hours field:** CPD_Hours_Current_Year__c
- **Maintenance window:** Managed by vendor — check Salesforce Trust status page

#### NetSuite (sys-005)

- **Description:** Enterprise resource planning system. The system of record for financial transactions, invoices, and member billing. Updated by MembershipRenewalOrchestrator and EmploymentUpdateListener (employment attributes only).
- **Type:** ERP
- **Technology:** NetSuite (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API (SuiteQL / REST Record API)
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** OAuth 1.0a
        - **Notes:** Token-based auth — integration credentials stored in Boomi connector config. Token rotation handled by IntegrationTeam.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** ERPTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** erp.support@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #erp-integrations
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.5%
    - **RTO:** 4 hours
    - **RPO:** 2 hours
- **Common issues:**
    - API rate limiting during concurrent renewal batch runs
    - Duplicate invoice detection when retry logic fires after a partial commit
    - Token expiry causing 401 errors — requires IntegrationTeam to rotate credentials
- **Key fields:**
    - **Member ID field:** custbody_member_id
    - **Invoice status field:** status
    - **Membership tier field:** custbody_membership_tier
- **Maintenance window:** Managed by vendor — check NetSuite status page

#### EventManagementSystem (sys-006)

- **Description:** System used to manage CPD events, workshops, and webinars. Receives registration and cancellation events from EventRegistrationSync.
- **Type:** Event Management Platform
- **Technology:** Generic SaaS (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** API Key
        - **Notes:** Event IDs must exist in this system before MemberPortal exposes them for registration. Sync lag between event creation and portal publication can cause ID-not-found errors.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** IntegrationTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** integration.ops@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #integration-platform
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 98.0%
    - **RTO:** 8 hours
    - **RPO:** 4 hours
- **Common issues:**
    - Event ID not found — event exists in Salesforce but not yet provisioned in EventManagementSystem
    - Cancellation requests fail if registration record was manually deleted
- **Maintenance window:** Managed by vendor

### External (layer-004)

- **Description:** Third-party services outside organisational control. The integration platform connects to these, but SLAs and incident response are governed by vendor agreements. Monitor vendor status pages for outages.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** IntegrationTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** integration.ops@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #integration-platform

#### PaymentGateway (sys-007)

- **Description:** Third-party payment processing service used during membership renewal and upgrade flows. Transaction results are written back to NetSuite by MembershipRenewalOrchestrator.
- **Type:** Payment Gateway
- **Technology:** Generic payment provider (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** External SaaS
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** API Key (HTTPS)
        - **Notes:** Timeout threshold set at 30s in Boomi connector config. Idempotency key used on retry to prevent double-charge.
- **Owning team:** Not specified (null)
- **Vendor status page:** https://status.paymentgateway.example.com (fictionalised)
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.95% (vendor-stated)
    - **RTO:** Vendor-managed
    - **RPO:** Vendor-managed
- **Common issues:**
    - Timeout on high-traffic days (e.g. renewal deadline)
    - Webhook delivery failures causing NetSuite invoice not to update
- **Maintenance window:** Vendor-managed — check status page

#### NotificationService (sys-008)

- **Description:** Transactional email and SMS delivery service. Used by MembershipRenewalOrchestrator to send confirmation emails to members.
- **Type:** Messaging / Notification Service
- **Technology:** Generic notification SaaS (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** External SaaS
- **Integration role:** target
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** REST API
        - **Direction:** inbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - Boomi
        - **Auth method:** API Key
        - **Notes:** Failures here do not block the renewal flow — they are logged as warnings. Member can request manual resend.
- **Owning team:** Not specified (null)
- **Vendor status page:** https://status.notificationservice.example.com (fictionalised)
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.9% (vendor-stated)
    - **RTO:** Vendor-managed
    - **RPO:** Vendor-managed
- **Common issues:**
    - Soft bounce on invalid member email — logged but non-blocking
    - Rate limiting during bulk renewal sends
- **Maintenance window:** Vendor-managed

### Security (layer-005)

- **Description:** Identity and access management systems. Not involved in integration data flows — issues at this layer are routed to InfrastructureTeam, not the Applications team.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** InfrastructureTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** infra.support@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #infra-support

#### IdentityProvider (sys-009)

- **Description:** Manages member and staff authentication (SSO, password reset, MFA, account lockout). Member login to MemberPortal is handled here. Not part of the integration data flows managed by Boomi.
- **Type:** Identity Provider
- **Technology:** Generic IdP / SSO (fictionalised)
- **Environment:** Cloud-hosted
- **Integration role:** standalone
- **Exposed interfaces:**
    - Item 1:
        - **Interface type:** SAML 2.0 / OIDC
        - **Direction:** outbound
        - **Consumers:**
            - MemberPortal
        - **Auth method:** Federation
        - **Notes:** MemberPortal delegates all login to IdentityProvider. No Boomi process involved.
- **Owning team:**
    - **Name:** InfrastructureTeam
    - **Escalation contact:** infra.support@example.com
    - **Slack channel:** #infra-support
- **SLA:**
    - **Availability:** 99.99%
    - **RTO:** 1 hour
    - **RPO:** Near-zero
- **Common issues:**
    - Account lockout after failed login attempts — self-service reset available
    - MFA token sync issues on device change
- **Maintenance window:** First Saturday of month 00:00–01:00 AEST

## Integration topology

- **Description:** Summary of how data flows between layers for the primary integration scenarios.

### Employment Update Flow (flow-001)

- **Path:**
    - MemberPortal
    - Boomi (EmploymentUpdateListener)
    - Salesforce
    - NetSuite
- **Direction:** left-to-right
- **Triggered by:** Member saves employment information on MemberPortal

### Membership Renewal Flow (flow-002)

- **Path:**
    - MemberPortal
    - Boomi (MembershipRenewalOrchestrator)
    - PaymentGateway
    - Salesforce
    - NetSuite
    - NotificationService
- **Direction:** left-to-right
- **Triggered by:** Member completes renewal or upgrade on MemberPortal

### Event Registration Flow (flow-003)

- **Path:**
    - MemberPortal
    - Boomi (EventRegistrationSync)
    - EventManagementSystem
    - Salesforce
- **Direction:** left-to-right
- **Triggered by:** Member registers for or cancels a CPD event

### Contact Details Update Flow (flow-004)

- **Path:**
    - MemberPortal
    - Boomi (ContactDetailsSyncProcess)
    - Salesforce
    - NetSuite
    - Sitecore
- **Direction:** left-to-right
- **Triggered by:** Member updates contact details on MemberPortal

### CPD Declaration Flow (flow-005)

- **Path:**
    - MemberPortal
    - Boomi (CPDDeclarationIngestion)
    - Salesforce
- **Direction:** left-to-right
- **Triggered by:** Member submits a CPD activity declaration

## Prototype investigation scope

Only Sitecore, Salesforce, Boomi and NetSuite have platform-assignment support in this prototype. MemberPortal is the reporting/source application; it is not a separate assignable platform. PaymentGateway, NotificationService, EventManagementSystem and IdentityProvider remain architectural dependencies outside platform-assignment scope. Record relevant evidence and request human investigation when it points outside the supported platforms; do not substitute a supported platform merely to assign the ticket. Process ownership and platform-routing groups serve different purposes.

EventRegistrationSync (proc-g3c4d5e6), CPDDeclarationIngestion (proc-i5e6f7g8) and MemberFeedbackRouter (proc-j6f7g8h9) are recognized process candidates with no retained process articles or execution logs. An empty result is unavailable evidence, not proof of successful processing.

## Additional legacy process

Listener - ecr Order Update (proc-k7g8h9i0) transfers incoming ECR orders to NetSuite cash sales. It remains documented in CONF-PROC-ECR and recognized by the Boomi tool, with no retained execution logs. It is separate from MembershipRenewalOrchestrator; the supplied five topology flows do not describe this legacy process.
